decisions.reason: The minimum quantity lubrication line sits close to the firm's coolant and fluid-handling know-how, and its in-house R&D can interpret customer feedback and refine the models, so the firm can absorb and build on it rather than abandon it.

The hydrocyclone coolant filter extends the firm's established filtration platform, where its engineering knowledge and modular systems let it learn from early results and improve the product, which favours keeping it.
The gravity band coolant filter is a core filtration product closely tied to the firm's existing offer and spare-parts business, so it fits its absorptive base well and is unlikely to be dropped.
